agents.label: codebase-audit
agents.prompt:
You are auditing the SBPS Supply Radar Python codebase to find concrete IMPROVEMENT opportunities.

PROJECT: SBPS Supply Radar — AI signal monitor for Single Barrel Power Solutions, a turnkey broker in industrial power generation equipment.
CORE THESIS: Equipment availability IS the product (supply-starved market). The alpha is TIME-TO-SIGNAL — finding surplus/available equipment before broker chains form and mark up prices. SBPS is sole intermediary: title holder <-> SBPS <-> buyer, transparent 1/1/1 commission.
MODEL: title holder <-> SBPS <-> buyer. Global scope (50/60Hz, voltage, grid code, logistics are hard match gates). Title-holder verification is non-negotiable (distinguish real owners from brokers claiming to represent sellers).
PIPELINE: Collect -> Classify (LLM) -> Enrich -> Cross-reference contacts -> Score -> Call sheet. SQLite store with dedup.
CURRENT SOURCES: EIA-860 (plant retirements/generator status), SEC EDGAR 8-K (mergers/bankruptcies/asset dispositions), FERC eLibrary (project withdrawals/permit cancellations), PACER (bankruptcy filings with listed equipment assets).
KNOWN STATUS (from handoff): EIA collector yields 3892 raw signals -> 521 after dedup -> 39 unique companies. SEC 8-K via Atom feed works. Buyer matching: 114 buyers loaded, 514/521 signals match >=1 buyer. Contact matching: 39 seller companies ALL blind spots (none in buyer list). Call sheet ranked by alpha. SQLite dedup + actionable_contacts.csv export. 32 tests passing, lint clean.
PHASE PLAN: Phase 1 (now) = public signal monitoring + call sheet. Phase 2 = cert partner intake, title verification, frequency/voltage matching, blind-spot discovery, persistence hardening. Phase 3 = auction house foundation, insurance partnerships, broker registry.
NAMED HIGH-ALPHA FUTURE SOURCES: certification partners (inspect equipment before any sale -> see distress FIRST; highest alpha but needs relationship setup), auction houses, insurance partners, broker registry. Also mentioned: behind-the-meter/data-center self-gen, turbine blade failures -> repair quotes -> sell decision, conference attendee lists as discovery, new surplus sitting in warehouses (cancelled projects, bankrupt developers).

YOUR TASK: Read the actual source under src/Sbps/ (files: cli.py, models.py, store.py, config.py, classifier.py, enricher.py, matcher.py, scorer.py, verifier.py, call_sheet.py, buyer_matcher.py, cert_intake.py, llm/client.py, collectors/base.py, collectors/eia.py, collectors/sec.py, collectors/ferc.py, collectors/pacer.py). Read the ones relevant to each finding.

Identify concrete improvement opportunities. Look for: collectors specced but not fully built (FERC, PACER), weak/naive scoring, missing or shallow enrichment, LLM classifier quality/prompt issues, missing error handling/retries/rate-limiting, pagination/dedup gaps, no scheduling/automation, title verification not implemented, frequency/voltage matching gaps, blind-spot discovery logic quality, buyer-matcher match-gate rigor, observability/logging, test coverage holes, config/secrets handling, data freshness. Also flag quick wins vs deeper work.

For EACH opportunity return one item. kind="internal". evidence MUST cite real file paths/functions you actually read. alphaRationale must tie to time-to-signal or deal-quality. feasibility = what it takes. effort S/M/L. phase = which phase it maps to. priority 1 (highest) to 5. Aim for 8-14 grounded items.

Return JSON matching the schema.
